dialogues.speaker: Nadyushenka
dialogues.text: Yes, risks... And who are you!? Gave me a real fright back there.

dialogues.speaker: Nadyushenka
dialogues.text: You look like an experienced adventurer to me, so you must understand my concerns.

dialogues.speaker: Nadyushenka
dialogues.text: I mean, what if I get pegged as a swindler? Just because the customs at the border are different from home?

dialogues.speaker: Nadyushenka
dialogues.text: Or what if the train I'm on derails, and I'm seated far, far away from the emergency exit? How am I supposed to get out then?

dialogues.speaker: Nadyushenka
dialogues.text: Or what if I have to spend the night out in the wilderness for some reason? With the air so cold, am I likely to suffocate in my sleep???

dialogues.speaker: Nadyushenka
dialogues.text: Besides... what if a Weasel Thief robs me blind in my sleep? Or what if someone takes my map from me after hearing that I'm out on a long trip for the very first time?

dialogues.speaker: Nadyushenka
dialogues.text: Adventures can be so tough... Maybe I should think of a perfect plan first before I set out.
